probe_detail.name: States a concrete limitation or scope condition of its own claim
Names the specific prior approach it improves on and how
Use of the Oxford (serial) comma in lists

final.name: Claims a previously infeasible capability vs incremental benchmark bump
final.audit_justification: Distinguishes a genuine new-capability claim from a routine incremental benchmark bump, which is real evidence about the substance of the contribution.

final.name: One decisive result vs scattered multi-benchmark deltas
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the evidentiary structure of the abstract centers on one decisive test versus diffuse incremental deltas, a substantive property of the argument itself.

final.name: Acronym and Method Branding Density
final.audit_justification: Purely counts a naming/branding convention (acronym use) and explicitly disclaims judging whether the name is good, though the practice may track more experienced entrants.

final.name: Quantified improvement claims stated with units
final.audit_justification: Purely counts numeric-figure-with-units occurrences and explicitly disclaims judging whether the gains are meaningful, though heavy quantification may track a more rigorous evaluation culture.
final.upstream_parent: the sub-community's benchmark-table reporting convention and the authors' habit of foregrounding headline figures in the abstract

final.name: Formal claims quantified, with the conditions they hold under
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a theoretical claim is stated precisely enough (rate, size, conditions) to be contradicted, a genuine rigor and checkability signal.

final.name: Dense inline mathematical notation
final.audit_justification: Purely measures the visual density of math notation and explicitly disclaims judging correctness or quality, though density may track a more formal subfield.

final.name: Explicit code/model-release disclosure sentence
final.audit_justification: Purely measures presence/prominence of a release-disclosure sentence and explicitly disclaims judging whether release is good practice, though it may track labs with the resources to actually open-source.
final.upstream_parent: author's/lab's practice in the format (open-source engineering culture)

final.name: Extent of coverage listing and breadth-signalling phrasing
final.audit_justification: Purely counts coverage items and breadth phrases and explicitly states this is not a quality judgement, though thorough coverage may track a more rigorous evaluation culture.
final.parent: Extent of coverage listing and breadth vocabulary
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Extent of coverage listing and breadth vocabulary

final.name: Sharp identification of fundamental flaws in established methods
final.audit_justification: Rewards identifying a specific, non-obvious structural or mathematical failure mode in prior work, a genuine intellectual contribution.

final.name: Single dominant insight vs. multi-component aggregation
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the contribution is organized around one graspable unifying idea versus unmotivated aggregation of parts, a real coherence-of-contribution property.

final.name: Late-riff framing
final.audit_justification: Purely measures a rhetorical framing choice (revision/extension/unification language) and explicitly disclaims judging whether the positioning is good or novel; framing is a writing choice largely decoupled from the underlying work's quality.

final.name: Evaluation-to-claim alignment
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the described evaluation setup actually matches the scope of the stated claims, a core rigor and overclaiming check.

final.name: Native Modeling of Solution Structure
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the technical formulation genuinely represents the structure of the problem rather than collapsing it, a substantive modeling-quality signal.

final.name: Density of formal vocabulary and mathematical notation
final.audit_justification: Purely counts formal-vocabulary and notation markers and explicitly states this is not a quality judgement, though density may track a more formal subfield or author practice.
final.parent: Density of formal vocabulary and mathematical notation on the page
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Density of formal vocabulary and mathematical notation on the page

final.name: Artifact and compliance boilerplate
final.audit_justification: Purely measures presence of release/ethics/compliance boilerplate sentences and explicitly disclaims judging the compliance as commendable; much of this is venue-mandated template text unconnected to research quality.

final.name: Improvement stated against prior results rather than prior systems
final.audit_justification: Rewards precisely identifying which specific prior result or bound is displaced and how, a genuine rigor-of-positioning signal.

final.name: Contribution isolation
final.audit_justification: Rewards demonstrating which component causes which effect via controlled variants versus bundling contributions without attribution, a real methodological-rigor signal.

final.name: Evidential force of the experiments actually described
final.audit_justification: Explicitly rewards genuine checkable evidentiary content over enumeration, the canonical real-quality criterion in this set.
final.parent: Enumeration count of evaluation settings and resource markers

final.name: Promotional claim density
final.audit_justification: Purely counts promotional/superlative words and explicitly disclaims judging whether the claims are good or true, a near-universal rhetorical convention decoupled from quality.

final.name: Formalization via Fundamental Mathematical Constructs
final.audit_justification: Rewards grounding the method in a named 'fundamental' math domain versus standard architectures, which functions as a subfield/topic marker rather than an execution-quality signal, though such subfields may have a stronger rigor culture.
final.arbiter_reason: As written, the instruction assigns 10 to any abstract naming a 'fundamental' math domain and 0 to any CNN/Transformer method regardless of how well either is executed, so it scores subfield/topic membership rather than the rigor or soundness of the work. It is mixed because theory-grounded subfields plausibly carry a stronger rigor culture that also produces genuine quality.

final.name: Count of named evaluation settings and resource markers
final.audit_justification: Purely counts named evaluation settings and resource markers and explicitly states this is not a quality judgement, though the count may track a more thorough evaluation culture.
final.parent: Enumeration count of evaluation settings and resource markers
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Enumeration count of evaluation settings and resource markers

final.name: Precision and checkability of the stated claim, notation aside
final.audit_justification: Explicitly rewards precision and checkability of the claim itself independent of notation, the canonical real-quality counterpart to notation-density counting.
final.parent: Density of formal vocabulary and mathematical notation on the page

final.name: Scope earned by reported variation across genuinely different regimes
final.audit_justification: Explicitly rewards genuinely demonstrated variation across differing conditions over mere breadth-claiming, a real generality and rigor signal.
final.parent: Extent of coverage listing and breadth vocabulary

final.name: Cross-setting generality
final.audit_justification: Judges whether one coherent formulation is actually applied with a shared rationale across varied settings versus generality merely being asserted, a substantive generality signal.

final.name: Boundary-Regime Characterization
final.audit_justification: Rewards analyzing limiting cases, counterexamples, and failure conditions rather than only typical operation, a genuine analytical-thoroughness signal.
